fields.summary_ko.0: TSM is trading at $405.87 as of 9:41 a.m. ET on November 4, up 0.26%; October revenue will be disclosed on November 10 to confirm whether quarterly growth ambitions are being met.
fields.summary_ko.1: Management guided Q4 revenue to $52.3–$54.3 billion (midpoint $53.3 billion) with operating margin of 56.5–58.5%, representing approximately 14.1% sequential growth versus prior quarter's approximately $46.7 billion, warranting close review of monthly revenue data.
